name: recognition-requirements-dev-suby-v1
scope: consumed development only; no new holdout/generalization/release evidence

contract.name: recognition-requirements-dev-suby-v1
contract.purpose: Measure useful stored-answer recognition coverage from a contradiction-only requirement filter against the unchanged reconstruction control.

policy.query_authority: statement text only; no expected key, source text, starter, signature or independent output enters query parsing
policy.source_authority: unchanged curated profile facts bound by exact indexed statement SHA256; no ID-specific policy branches
policy.query_parser: Existing explicit grammar, with additional conservative negation, uncertainty, alternative and quoted-context suppression; unrecognized paraphrases remain unknown. Conflicting retained facts abstain. No inferred defaults.
policy.ordering_direction: An arbitrary-order source supports sorted input, so sorted query versus arbitrary source alone is not a contradiction. An unsorted query contradicts a sorted-only source precondition.
policy.selection: Apply unchanged public-interface filter, then contradiction-only source-contract exclusion. Leave unknown and unapproved sources visible; preserve all raw identities, order, scores and cosine. Apply existing score/general/sibling gates to remaining candidates. Check source approval, then exactly one public execution; failure abstains. Exact and no-example routes unchanged.
policy.implementation: Opt-in lookup adapter; existing answer.py and execution code unchanged. Candidate repeats the deterministic interface filter inside answer(); measured overhead retained.
policy.thresholds: Existing frozen statement score/general-margin and sibling-margin values unchanged. No score boost, candidate expansion, model fitting or threshold fitting.

contract.freeze: After deterministic synthetic development tests pass, freeze implementation, tests, contracts, dependencies, check receipt, all control contents/mtimes, payloads, source approval, fixture and vector identities in candidate.json before comparative inference or judge execution.

accounting.source_vectors: Reuse the original 66 vectors without remeasurement; disclose cached index setup.
accounting.queries: One freshly measured query embedding and raw retrieval per eligible retained request, shared identically by both arms. Save the vector and full raw list. No-example controls have no embedding.
accounting.arms: Alternate arm order by fixed request index. Measure each arm including opt-in filtering, approval, adaptation and public execution while replaying shared inputs. Charge the measured shared embedding/retrieval time to each arm; disclose this charge and avoid calling replay time fresh inference.
accounting.complete_cost: Report actual paired wall (including first load, guards and receipt I/O), process and child CPU, sampled process-tree RSS and disk. Separately report encoder load/hash verification, warm charged route phases and post-decision scoring. Cached stages retain original measured times; completed resume performs no inference/judging. No exclusive-host performance claim.
accounting.budgets: Each arm receives the original route/judge budget with measured shared retrieval subtracted from remaining route time.

contract.evidence: Save complete raw and pre/post-interface/requirement shortlists, all identities and qualification reasons, query facts/spans/suppressions/conflicts, source facts/hashes, contradictions, first choices, gates/margins, public errors and abstentions. Preserve local code-bearing responses and test payloads, never publish them. Seal all 48 public decisions before independent scoring.

reporting_selection_rule.primary: All 24 requests retained, with specified16 and pre-retrieval8 reported separately. Correct requires returned code, intended identity, unchanged source approval and passing permitted independent source suite. Report correct/wrong/unqualified acceptances, abstentions and infrastructure errors for both arms.
reporting_selection_rule.useful: Candidate correct and control not correct on the same retained request.
reporting_selection_rule.harmful: Loss of a control-correct answer, or newly introduced wrong/unqualified acceptance or infrastructure failure.
reporting_selection_rule.retain_as_development_candidate: At least one useful change, no harmful changes, no candidate wrong/unqualified acceptances or infrastructure failures, both arms within original per-request budgets and resource envelope, and no unexplained control disposition drift from the original pilot. This selects a development candidate only; it does not change a release gate or set final 1b coverage.
reporting_selection_rule.negative_result: Complete and retain the experiment even if selection fails; do not tune this frozen candidate on its results.
reporting_selection_rule.release: No release promotion or fresh confirmation from these consumed requests. Existing release gates remain unchanged.

contract.failures_resume: Atomic hash-bound immutable stage receipts. Source/input/dependency/receipt drift rejects resume. Preserve failures locally. sandbox_error represents infrastructure failure; no unsandboxed fallback or host-security changes.
limitations: Consumed development requests and curated profiles; no new holdout, generalization, semantic equivalence or learned-solving evidence.
Same LCD shortlist and newly public-example-augmented fixtures as the reconstruction pilot; no historical full-catalog reproduction claim.
Finite imported source tests are not independently authored query tests or benchmark acceptance.
Eight controls lack public examples and stop before retrieval; no semantic ambiguity/absence claim.
Unknown and missing requirements remain unknown; this conservative grammar can lose coverage.
Three below-floor matches cannot be fixed by contradiction exclusion; island unprofiled/unapproved candidates may still lead.
Original composer/checkpoint/corpus identities and protected evaluations remain untouched.

source_profile_review: Existing 22 bound source contracts inspected against permitted indexed statements before inference. Curated metadata, not semantic proof; no profiles added or changed.
source_approval: Reuse exactly the original 16-source qualification and all exclusions; unchanged answer/execution implementation verified against its manifest.
